rewritten: Rulebook Entry: In the event of a BPL (Bilateral Payment Liability) card lapse, the customer will receive a written notice from the Water Utility Company outlining the steps to reinstate the account. Reinstatement will require a new application form, a small fee, and a credit check to reassess eligibility for the Water Utility Company's services. Customers are advised to keep their contact information up-to-date to receive timely communication regarding their account status.
